note: A LIQUID is a fluid that fills liquid containers by volume (see liquid_container.schema.json). It is never carried or placed on its own and has no model. Its WEIGHT is properties.weight_kg = kilograms PER LITRE (water 1.0, diesel 0.83); what a container weighs is its own weight plus liters x this. Ids start with liquid_.

color.label: Fluid Color
color.note: The fluid colour as #RRGGBB (the swatch). It tints the liquid shown in a container.

opacity_pct.label: Opacity (%)
opacity_pct.note: How opaque the fluid is: 100 = fully opaque (milk, cream), about 70 for fuels, about 35 for water, 0 = invisible. Drives how much of the container shows through the liquid.

flammable.label: Flammable
flammable.note: Burns or explodes near fire (fuels, oils, kerosene, propane).
